# EverSafe Fire Protection

> Florida-licensed fire protection engineering and consulting.

EverSafe Fire Protection is a Florida-licensed professional engineering practice.
We design and review fire protection systems.
A Florida-licensed Professional Engineer prepares or reviews every deliverable.
We produce code-compliant, permit-ready documents.
Most fixed-fee proposals go out within one business day.

Service area: Florida. We are based in Central Florida and serve the whole state.

We work with MEP engineering firms, architecture firms, design-build sprinkler and
alarm contractors, general contractors, and building owners and facility managers.

## Services

- [NFPA 13 Fire Sprinkler System Design](https://eversafe-fire.com/#nfpa-13-sprinkler-design): Wet, dry, pre-action, and antifreeze systems. Hydraulic calculations, water supply analysis, and PE-stamped shop drawings for permit submittal.
- [NFPA 72 Fire Alarm and Detection Design](https://eversafe-fire.com/#nfpa-72-fire-alarm-design): Device layout, riser diagrams, battery and voltage-drop calculations, sequence of operations, and sealed submittal packages.
- [PE Review and Seal](https://eversafe-fire.com/#pe-seal-plan-review): Third-party plan review and PE sealing of sprinkler and fire alarm drawings. Delegated design sign-off, comment resolution, and resubmittal support.
- [Code Consulting and Risk Analysis](https://eversafe-fire.com/#code-consulting-risk-analysis): Life safety and egress analysis, fire risk analysis, and code compliance studies. Florida Building Code and NFPA 101. Alternative means and methods support with your AHJ.
- [Fire and Smoke Modeling](https://eversafe-fire.com/#fire-smoke-modeling): Performance-based design using Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS). Smoke control analysis, tenability studies, atrium and warehouse modeling, and egress simulation.
- [Mission-Critical and Special Hazards](https://eversafe-fire.com/#mission-critical-special-hazards): Data centers and mission-critical facilities. Energy storage per NFPA 855. Clean agent suppression per NFPA 2001. Commissioning support.
